title: Perpendicular Axis Theorem for Planar Laminas

variables.I_z: Moment of inertia about normal axis perpendicular to lamina through origin O
variables.I_x: Moment of inertia about coplanar x-axis passing through O
variables.I_y: Moment of inertia about coplanar y-axis passing through O

assumptions: Rigid body is strictly a two-dimensional planar lamina lying entirely in the xy-plane (z = 0)
All three axes x, y, and z are mutually perpendicular and intersect at a single concurrent origin O
validity_conditions: Strictly valid ONLY for two-dimensional planar laminar bodies; fails identically for three-dimensional bodies
common_misuse: Applying the theorem to three-dimensional objects (e.g. solid cylinders or spheres)
Using axes that do not intersect at a common coplanar point
